validationScope: Comparison tooling and source/probe-backed design; no native runtime acceptance

requestContext.fingerprint: SHA256 of original bytes, recomputed by comparator and required to match both observations
requestContext.mutation: Request and observation objects must not be modified by comparison

scope.successfulGraphs: Flat root and child nodes with string identity, given finite nonnegative sizes and single-source/single-target extended root edges
scope.shapeMapping: Root maps to root; children preserve IDs, count and order; no sorting or positional remapping to another ID
scope.optionalShapeCollections: Absent or empty typed arrays may be accepted; nonempty ports/labels/nested child graphs are outside v1
scope.constructorAndArguments: Mappings only, as required by the existing layout request schema
scope.optionContainers: constructor.defaultLayoutOptions, layoutArguments.layoutOptions and root layoutOptions must be absent or mappings; explicit null/falsy scalars are outside successful native-profile scope even when JS accepts them

scopeOrder: explicit call layoutOptions; an empty mapping replaces constructor defaults
constructor defaultLayoutOptions only when call layoutOptions is absent
selectors.sameScopeMultipleAliases: Reject in v1 even if values match; this profile does not silently reproduce an unverified resolver

scope.workerParameters: Any explicit constructor workerUrl or workerFactory key, including null/false, is outside native profile scope
scope.loggingAndTiming: Absent or valid boolean flags may be diagnosed; all result logging/timing fields remain exact and are never ignored
scope.errorCases: Compare exact named errors with preserved inputs; invalid graph values are not converted by truthiness; only the explicitly described generated shape-hash reference mutation may be projected
scope.alternateCoordinateFrames: No acceptance claim for non-default flat coordinate frames
scope.unsupported: Fail closed without changing the raw strict report; do not infer runtime rejection of business data from a comparison profile scope failure
scope.existingUserHashPolicy: For each original root/child shape with a $H key, reference and candidate result/inputAfter must preserve its original key/value exactly. Any reference overwrite is a native precondition failure even if candidate copies the same overwritten value. This profile rejection does not authorize a runtime to drop or reject caller business data.
scope.constructorAlgorithmRegistration: For a successful observation, an explicit constructor.algorithms must be a list of strings including literal short name layered. Additional string entries are layout-diagnostic context only, not evidence of any other algorithm registration or metadata compatibility. Missing list uses the reference default.
scope.coordinateFrameControls: Check global and every root/child shape layoutOptions; explicit json.shapeCoords/json.edgeCoords accept only INHERIT in v1. Non-INHERIT frame values and INCLUDE_CHILDREN hierarchy handling are outside v1; do not infer a default frame from truthiness.

adaptations.candidateRequirement: Exact original graph, including every business field, user-provided geometry and key presence
referenceSuccessPreconditions: Reference inputAfter exactly equals its returned result
Reference constructorAfter and argumentsAfter exactly equal request constructor and layoutArguments
referenceErrorPreconditions: Reference graph is exactly original after removing only verified newly added root/child shape $H fields
Reference constructorAfter and argumentsAfter exactly equal original request values
adaptations.reporting: Retain complete raw differences and list this explicit input-ownership adaptation; never project candidate input mutations away

preconditions: Corresponding original shape had no $H key
Reference added a finite integer $H; bool is excluded
Original/reference/candidate shape identity and child order match
Candidate must not contain an unrequested shape $H
adaptations.action: Project only the qualifying reference-added shape field for public-contract comparison, report each actual path/value/rule; keep raw observation intact
neverAdapt: Candidate-generated $H, even if equal to reference

protectedFields.businessFields: Full recursive strict equality outside declared geometry numeric paths
protectedFields.modelArrays: Original order and identity; no sorting
protectedFields.coordinates: Existing geometric path tolerance only: abs=1e-6, rel=1e-9; no translation/scaling
protectedFields.candidateThreeInputs: graph, constructor and layout arguments exact to original request; coordinate tolerance does not apply to input preservation

errorContract.comparison: Exact, with no generic exception-class normalization or message stripping
errorContract.pythonDesign: Future compatibility exceptions may expose an explicit JS-compatible name; Python internal imports/adapter failures must remain harness failures
errorContract.unknownError: Remain a raw mismatch or out-of-scope result; never count as compatible by category alone

reportContract.legacyExactAndCoordinateTolerance: Retain raw strict meanings for backward compatibility
nativePassedRequires: Valid original-byte request fingerprint and supported scope
Public returned result or named error within existing coordinate policy
reportContract.rawStrict: Full contract exact and tolerance differences remain independently visible
reportContract.geometryAndDeterminism: Separate checks; profile pass alone does not establish either
reportContract.profileDefinition: Require status frozen-design and revision exactly integer 1, excluding bool; draft/unrecognized definitions are rejected.

hostDesign.status: design-only; implementation and lifecycle tests belong to E03/E08
hostDesign.missingVersusNull: Use key-presence/sentinels, not truthiness. JSON null/false/0/empty string are distinct from omitted/undefined. The request schema does not represent JS undefined; contract probes record its kind separately.
hostDesign.pythonConvenienceNone: The planned options=None/args=None Python conveniences denote omitted outer options. This explicit host API design is not a claim that JS null has the same semantics, and is not accepted as null in the JSON request profile.
hostDesign.optionsPrecedence: Call layoutOptions replaces constructor defaultLayoutOptions, even {}; root local options win. Unsupported scalar option containers are rejected by the v1 comparison scope rather than silently merged/coerced.
hostDesign.inputOwnership: Run on a separate per-call work graph; preserve caller graph, options and arguments; return geometry/logging in the result. Repeated-call contract assertions must inspect returned results and original inputs separately.
hostDesign.workerParameters: Future Python API explicitly rejects supplied workerUrl/workerFactory; no JS worker or fallback backend is executed.

termination.target: Native close operation is idempotent, stops accepting new layout work and releases owned execution resources; not a promise to reproduce FakeWorker TypeError
termination.runningAndQueuedPolicy: Must be implemented and tested with the actual E08 execution model before being publicly claimed

concurrency.target: Separate per-call state; same-instance ordering/serialization must be explicit; separate instances must not share mutable layout state

cancellation.target: Propagate cancellation at defined dispatch/cooperative points; no preemptive CPU-phase latency guarantee from async syntax

observations.fact: JS null outer constructor/arguments throw synchronously in the locked bundled entry; they are not equivalent to omission.
Several falsy scalar forms are accepted by JS coercion, but that is not automatic native-profile support.
Call option mappings replace constructor defaults; root local direction overrides the selected global mapping.
The same JS graph is mutated: logging appears for the enabled call and is cleared by a subsequent default call; successful inputAfter equals result.
User-provided falsy root/child $H values are overwritten by the reference. These existing keys are never stripped or adapted by v1; fail closed and preserve the collision differences.
Truthy user root/child hashes and tested nested business/data hashes are preserved; all remain strict fields.
Tested layout errors add only previously missing shape hashes; original graph content is restored exactly when those verified new keys are removed.
Locked FakeWorker terminate throws TypeError and subsequent layout still succeeds; this is not a native close contract or lifecycle parity proof.

The tested constructor defaultLayoutOptions undefined/empty/null/false/zero/empty-string shapes all return successfully in JS; non-mapping explicit values remain outside the conservative native successful profile.
